_note: Intro Nokon layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255, or AARRGGBB hex strings where the key's value is a string. Opacities, shades and scales 0 to 1 (a scale may exceed 1).

loading._note: The text shown while the songs load.

curtain._note: Each curtain half is half_w wide (it slides that far).

opening._note: The title menu: the logo's top-left (the light turns around its centre), Nokon's top-left, the Start button's centre and the Back button's top-left.

rolls._note: The three rolls (mode, players, songs), centred on center_x at y[i]. Items sit at most max_gap and at least min_gap apart, fitting max_total_w when they can (item_fallback stands in for an item art's size before it loads). The chosen item is drawn at selected_scale, the others at other_scale; a roll's label sits label_gap above its tallest item. An inactive roll is drawn at inactive_opacity. Item tints: selected_color, other_color, unavailable_color; labels: active_label_color, label_color.

rounds._note: The VS round count step, over a veil of veil_opacity.

stands._note: The players' stands, their centres at y: a solo player at solo_x, more players spread from range_lo to range_hi (padding further in when fewer than 5). The body, head and hands are drawn body_dy / head_dy / hands_dy from the stand's centre, the score score_dy. Each player has its colour (player_colors, AARRGGBB); a denied player's body is denied_body_color times denied_body_shade, its head and hands denied_color, its stand denied_stand_color.

blackboard._note: The text on the stage panel, centred.

clock._note: Clock.png's top-right (x, y) and the seconds left centred at (num_x, num_y), in warn_color from warn_at_s seconds down.

list._note: The song and genre lists: rows_each_side entries above and below the chosen one, start_y for the topmost, spacing apart, on the SongList panel (top centre at bg_x, bg_y, at bg_opacity). An entry not chosen shows at other_opacity. The chosen entry's name is in highlight_color; on the panel names are tinted text_color (chosen) or other_text_color. genre_max_width is a genre label's widest.

results._note: The result screen over the closed curtain, centred on x: the header, Endurance's score and its high score list (high_score_rows rows from high_score_y, high_score_gap apart, the player's in the list's highlight colour), VS's ranking (vs_y + rank * vs_gap), the footer.

dialogue._note: Nokon slides in from nokon_x_out to nokon_x_in at nokon_y (top-left) beside the dialogue box (box, handed to the shared dialogue library with theme, the library's own key names, 0-255). Behind it the screen dims to fail_dim_opacity after an Endurance miss, vs_fail_dim_opacity after a VS round nobody found.
